title: Why DiT Models Underperform as Representation Learners without Long Skip Connections
title_zh: 为何在没有长跳跃连接时，DiT 模型作为表示学习器的表现不佳

paragraphs.en: 研究表明长跳跃连接有助于提高DiT模型的特征质量，从而改善生成与理解统一的表现。 Diffusion feature, i.e., intermediate activations extracted from diffusion model backbones, has emerged as a promising approach for unifying generation and vision understanding (discrimination). Despite the advancement of diffusion backbones into Diffusion Transformers (DiT), it has been found in previous literature that DiT models tend to yield weaker features despite their stronger generation capability. This poses a threat to good generation-understanding unification. In this work, we show via controlled from-scratch training that long skip connections (LSCs) affect feature quality: a DiT with LSCs can produce better features. Furthermore, through detailed diagnosis, we reveal the mechanism causing this effect. Specifically, the input to a diffusion backbone contains both the latent image and the diffusion noise, where the diffusion noise, though appearing in the form of noises, actually reflects the information of the diffusion trajectory. To make the final prediction of a noisy variable ($v$ or $ε$), the diffusion backbone needs both signals. However, carrying both signals through the main backbone effectively "pollutes" the image signal with noises, leading to poor feature quality. In comparison, LSCs can shortcut diffusion noises directly to where they are needed, leaving much weaker noise signals in the main backbone, thus improving feature quality. To name the broader impact, this reveals that LSCs are not a mere trick but closely related to the diffusion objective. The code is at https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-lsc.
paragraphs.zh: 研究表明，长跳跃连接有助于提升DiT模型的特征质量，从而改善生成与理解统一的表现。扩散特征（即从扩散模型主干中提取的中间激活值）已成为统一生成与视觉理解（判别）的一种有前景的方法。 尽管扩散主干已发展为扩散变换器（DiT），但以往文献发现，尽管DiT模型具有更强的生成能力，其生成的特征却往往较弱。 这对实现良好的生成-理解统一构成了威胁。 在本项工作中，我们通过从头开始的受控训练表明，长跳跃连接（LSCs）会影响特征质量：带有LSCs的DiT能够生成更优质的特征。 此外，通过详细分析，我们揭示了导致这一效应的机制。 具体来说，扩散主干的输入同时包含潜在图像和扩散噪声；其中，扩散噪声虽然表现为噪声形式，但实际上反映了扩散轨迹的信息。 为了对含噪声的变量（$v$ 或 $ε$）做出最终预测，扩散主干需要同时利用这两种信号。 然而，将两种信号都通过主主干传递，会有效“污染”图像信号，引入噪声，从而导致特征质量下降。 相比之下，LSCs可以直接将扩散噪声快捷地传递至所需位置，使主主干中的噪声信号大幅减弱，从而提升特征质量。 从更广泛的影响来看，这一发现表明LSCs并非简单的技巧，而是与扩散目标密切相关。 代码请访问 https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-lsc。
